description: This file defines a React functional component called LoginPage that handles user login. It manages form state for username and password, handles form submission by invoking a login function from context, navigates upon success, and displays potential error messages. It also renders a form with input fields and a link to the sign-up page.

methods.name: LoginPage()
methods.description: React functional component rendering a login form with state management, form submission handling, and navigation.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling form submission; calls login, navigates on success, catches and displays errors.
